invent = to create something that did not exist before
invention = a new thing that someone has created
discover = to find something that was not known before
scientist = a person who studies science and does experiments
experiment = a scientific test to learn what happens
laboratory = a room where scientists do tests
device = a machine or tool made for a particular job
gadget = a small, clever electronic object
smartphone = a mobile phone that can use the internet and apps
charger = the object that puts power into a battery
wireless = working without a cable
download = to copy a file from the internet onto your device
upload = to send a file from your device to the internet
log in = to enter a username and password to use a site
password = a secret word that lets you open an account
username = the name you use to log in
social media = websites and apps for sharing news and photos with others
post = a message you put on the internet; to put it there
share = to let other people see a file or post
search engine = a website that finds pages when you type words
